description: This is a Java source file implementing the CountryDaoImpl class, which interacts with the database to retrieve Country entities based on language filtering using QueryDSL.

classes.name: CountryDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Country Data Access Object, extending generic DAO and providing a method to list countries filtered by language.

methods.name: listByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Country entities associated with a specified Language, joining country descriptions and ordering by name.
